title: Recording: Old Siam Sir by Wings | 1978
content:
Spirit of Ranachan Studio, Low Ranachan Farm, Campbeltown, Scotland
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tim Summerhayes

Wings began recording the Back To The Egg song ‘Old Siam, Sir’ on 18 July 1978.

The song was based on a 1976 instrumental demo by Paul McCartney titled ‘Super Big Heatwave’. The middle section was suggested by drummer Steve Holley during a jam session.

The backing track had McCartney on Fender Rhodes electric piano, Denny Laine and Laurence Juber on electric guitars, and Holley on drums.

McCartney and Juber then overdubbed the lead guitar lines, with McCartney playing the lower notes in the solo on his Epiphone Casino, and Juber playing the higher notes on his Gibson Les Paul Custom.

‘Old Siam, Sir’ was completed with McCartney’s lead vocals.
